adoption_note: Candidate configuration. Nursing scope of practice and nurse-staffing law in the United States are set by STATE, not federally. No entry in this pack may be treated as locally adopted clinical policy until the deploying organisation records an explicit adoption decision naming the state and the pack version (FR-NS-170, NFR-NS-027).

early_warning.name: Facility-adopted aggregate early warning profile
early_warning.algorithm_note: There is no single United States national early-warning score. Facilities adopt MEWS, NEWS2, eCART or a proprietary deterioration index. The transportable NEWS2 bands are carried as a candidate so the mechanism is testable; the facility must load its adopted parameter table before clinical use.

2.label: Scale 2 - prescribed target range 88-92% in hypercapnic respiratory failure

safe_staffing.method_note: Federal Conditions of Participation require adequate numbers of licensed nurses but set no numeric ratio. Numeric ratios exist only where a state mandates them; elsewhere the facility staffing plan governs. The ward norms below are STATE overlays and are inert until a state is selected.
safe_staffing.roster_authority_note: Nursing Station consumes the roster through the BulletTrain hub and never authors it (NFR-NS-028).

state_overlays.citation: California licensed nurse-to-patient ratio regulation for medical-surgical units

ward_norms.note: No federal numeric norm. Zero means unset; the staffing position reports insufficient-policy rather than compliance.
No federal numeric norm. Zero means unset; the staffing position reports insufficient-policy rather than compliance.

declaration_policy.authority_note: A shortage declaration is a named human act. Nursing Station never declares automatically; it computes the position and presents it for decision (NFR-NS-030).

declaration_contract.model_note: The governed role-assumption model has no shortage severity, no role enum and no approval field. A declaration is active or it is not.

harm_incident.pressure_injury_classification: NPIAP stage 1-4, unstageable, deep tissue pressure injury

external_reporting.receiver: patient safety organisation using AHRQ Common Formats
external_reporting.receiver_authority: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
external_reporting.owner_note: Nursing Station records and reviews the ward incident and publishes it through the hub. It is not the national incident registry.

quality_measures.title: Registered nursing hours per patient day
quality_measures.numerator: registered nursing hours worked on the unit in the reporting period
quality_measures.denominator: occupied bed days in the reporting period

quality_measures.title: Registered nurse skill mix
quality_measures.numerator: registered nurse whole-time equivalents on duty
quality_measures.denominator: total nursing whole-time equivalents on duty

quality_measures.title: Missed nursing care rate
quality_measures.numerator: nursing tasks that reached their due time without completion or cancellation
quality_measures.denominator: nursing tasks due in the reporting period
exclusions: tasks cancelled before their due time

quality_measures.title: Falls with injury per 1000 occupied bed days
quality_measures.numerator: falls recorded with moderate or greater harm
quality_measures.denominator: occupied bed days in the reporting period

quality_measures.title: Hospital-acquired pressure injury rate (stage 2 and above)
quality_measures.numerator: pressure injuries of stage 2 or above that were not present on admission
quality_measures.denominator: occupied bed days in the reporting period
exclusions: injuries recorded as present on admission

quality_measures.title: Deterioration escalations answered within the required response interval
quality_measures.numerator: escalations with a recorded clinical response inside the profile response interval
quality_measures.denominator: escalations raised in the reporting period

quality_measures.title: Medication administration omissions
quality_measures.denominator: medication occurrences with a recorded outcome
exclusions: occurrences recorded as delayed and later administered
